# Tokens

Every token of the system, a section per group: Surfaces — 6 tokens; Text — 4 tokens; Fills and status backgrounds — 5 tokens; Borders and rings — 3 tokens; Palette ramps and brand — 7 tokens; Type styles, families, font files; Spacing — 8 tokens; Radius — 4 tokens; Shadow — 6 tokens; Chamfer — 3 tokens; Stroke — 2 tokens; Size — 7 tokens.

## Color · Surfaces

### Use

```css
/* in a page’s CSS: the token’s name, with its value from the same row of the table below as the fallback, so the page draws whether or not it links tokens.css */
color: var(--surface-canvas, #f6f5f2);
/* on a slide, in a chart’s options, or anywhere else var() cannot go, and in an SVG attribute such as fill, which not every browser reads var() in: the value alone */
color: #f6f5f2;
```

### Tokens (6)

| token | light | usage |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--surface-canvas` | #f6f5f2 | Main white-forward background (55–65% of any composition). Spec: surface.canvas. |
| `--surface-primary` | #ffffff | Cards, forms, command surfaces. Spec: surface.primary. |
| `--surface-sunken` | #eceae6 | DERIVED. Wells, tab-strip ground, table header rows, disabled fills. ink-secondary reads 6.38:1 on it. |
| `--surface-inverse` | #151519 | Matte-black architecture: utility rail, terminals, HUD panels, secondary buttons. Spec: surface.inverse. |
| `--surface-inverse-raised` | #2a2a30 | DERIVED. Raised layer on black: terminal title bar, hovered rail item. White reads 14.3:1. |
| `--surface-crimson-soft` | #fce8eb | Selected rows, active tab ground, annotations. ink-primary 15.5:1, accent-crimson 6.85:1 on it. Spec: surface.crimson-soft. |

## Type

Set text in one of the styles below: write its values from the Styles and Families tables, or, on a page that links or inlines tokens.css, prefer its variable, where the Styles table’s CSS column gives one.

### Use

```css
/* any surface: a style’s values from the Styles and Families tables */
font: 700 56px/60px "Space Grotesk", Inter, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; letter-spacing: -0.02em;
/* a page that links or inlines tokens.css: prefer the variables, so that a change to tokens.css reaches the page */
font: var(--text-display); letter-spacing: -0.02em;
font-family: var(--font-heading);   /* the family alone */
```

### Styles

| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |

### Font files

Fonts: `tokens.css` loads each font from its file, by path.

- **Design canvas:** copy `fonts/inter-latin-400-normal.woff2`, `fonts/inter-latin-500-normal.woff2`, `fonts/inter-latin-600-normal.woff2`, `fonts/space-grotesk-latin-500-normal.woff2`, `fonts/space-grotesk-latin-600-normal.woff2`, `fonts/space-grotesk-latin-700-normal.woff2`, `fonts/jetbrains-mono-latin-400-normal.woff2` and `fonts/jetbrains-mono-latin-500-normal.woff2` to the same paths under the canvas’s `project/ds/<folder>/` (`<folder>` is the folder you install this system under; `fonts/inter-latin-400-normal.woff2` lands on `project/ds/<folder>/fonts/inter-latin-400-normal.woff2`), in the same call that installs this system; the copy of `tokens.css` that each artboard links loads them from there. If the install’s reply leaves a font out, bring that font in as for any other page.
- **Slides deck:** for each family you use in the deck (`faces` holds at most the number of typefaces Slides’ `deck-files.md` gives), install its file with the system and name the path it lands on as that family’s `src` in `project/deck.json` `faces`, under the key in the Slides column. A deck takes a font as a file only under the rule in Slides’ `fonts.md` (no space or leading underscore in its path, for two): any other font, or one kept by id, is uploaded as `fonts.md` says.
- **Any other page:** one file per family is enough (below: the upright face nearest regular weight; bold and italic synthesize). Fetch it as the fetch column says (Artifact tool `read`, that id or path as `path`), upload it as an asset (`publish`, `file_path`, `asset:true`) and declare it with an `@font-face { font-family: "<family>"; src: url(<uploaded>) }` rule.

`tokens.css` carries the `@font-face` rules for a page that links it and names each family by the CSS variable below.

| family | file | fetch | CSS | Slides `faces` key |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Inter | `fonts/inter-latin-400-normal.woff2` (weight 400) | `read` the file with `project/` in front | `var(--font-sans)` | `inter` |
| Space Grotesk | `fonts/space-grotesk-latin-500-normal.woff2` (weight 500) | `read` the file with `project/` in front | `var(--font-heading)` | `space-grotesk` |
| JetBrains Mono | `fonts/jetbrains-mono-latin-400-normal.woff2` (weight 400) | `read` the file with `project/` in front | `var(--font-mono)` | `jetbrains-mono` |

Every face: `fonts/inter-latin-400-normal.woff2` (Inter, 400), `fonts/inter-latin-500-normal.woff2` (Inter, 500), `fonts/inter-latin-600-normal.woff2` (Inter, 600), `fonts/space-grotesk-latin-500-normal.woff2` (Space Grotesk, 500), `fonts/space-grotesk-latin-600-normal.woff2` (Space Grotesk, 600), `fonts/space-grotesk-latin-700-normal.woff2` (Space Grotesk, 700), `fonts/jetbrains-mono-latin-400-normal.woff2` (JetBrains Mono, 400), `fonts/jetbrains-mono-latin-500-normal.woff2` (JetBrains Mono, 500).

## Spacing

### Use

```css
/* any surface: a token’s value from the table below */
padding: 4px;
/* a page that links or inlines tokens.css: prefer the token’s name, so that a change to tokens.css reaches the page */
padding: var(--space-4);
```

### Tokens (8)

| token | value | usage |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--space-4` | 4px | Icon-to-text in compact chips; hairline gaps. |
| `--space-8` | 8px | Compact HUD internal spacing; gap between related controls. |
| `--space-12` | 12px | Compact HUD padding; list row gap. |
| `--space-16` | 16px | Panel padding (minimum); grid gutter. |
| `--space-24` | 24px | Panel padding (comfortable); card gap. |
| `--space-32` | 32px | Separation between major sections (minimum). |
| `--space-48` | 48px | Separation between major sections (generous); hero padding. |
| `--space-64` | 64px | Hero and page-level breathing room. |

## Chamfer

Phantom Cut: diagonal corner cut on top-right and bottom-left, clip-path polygon(0 0, calc(100% - c) 0, 100% c, 100% 100%, c 100%, 0 calc(100% - c)). Apply to a ::before fill so focus rings are never clipped.

### Use

```css
/* any surface: a token’s value from the table below (--chamfer-6: 6px) */
/* a page that links or inlines tokens.css: prefer var(--chamfer-6), so that a change to tokens.css reaches the page */
```

### Tokens (3)

| token | value | usage |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--chamfer-6` | 6px | Small controls, badges. |
| `--chamfer-10` | 10px | Buttons, inputs, HUD frames. |
| `--chamfer-16` | 16px | Hero frames, terminal panels. |
